blurb.en: Same 16-algorithm stereo FX engine as the 6HP Milky Way — hall, shimmer, plate and spring reverbs, tape echo, ping-pong delay, chorus, flanger, ring mod, overdrive, compressor, freeze — laid out across a 22HP 1U tile instead.
blurb.fi: Sama 16-algoritminen stereo-FX-moottori kuin 6HP:n Milky Wayssa — hall-, shimmer-, plate- ja spring-kaiut, tape echo, ping-pong-viive, chorus, flanger, rengasmodulaatio, overdrive, kompressori, freeze — tällä kertaa 22HP:n 1U-laatalla.
blurb.sv: Samma 16-algoritmers stereo-FX-motor som i 6HP-versionen av Milky Way — hall-, shimmer-, plate- och spring-reverb, tape echo, ping-pong-delay, chorus, flanger, ringmodulering, overdrive, kompressor, freeze — den här gången på en 22HP 1U-platta.

pull.q: Milky Way 1U by Endorphin.es offers the wonderful stereo effects found in the original repackaged for the Intellijel 1U format.
